title: 1DSink Along-Trench Morphometric Framework
description: MATLAB pipeline for one-dimensional along-trench morphometric decomposition and sediment-trapping (Trapping Index) analysis of the Kuril-Kamchatka Trench, validated against independent surface-sediment geochemistry. Accompanies the article 'Morphology segregates contaminant accumulation along hadal trenches'.
